index.title: Interview assistant
index.subtitle: Prepare structured interviews, conduct them over Alexandria's live room, and create a consent-aware local record.
index.privacyValue: Local record · explicit consent · timed deletion
index.emptyDescription: Create a plan with participants, criteria, retention, and consent settings.
index.candidatePlaceholder: Name shown in the private record
index.recordDescription: The attributed transcript is the durable record. Raw audio and video recording remain off in this privacy-first release. Transcription stays off when on-device processing cannot be guaranteed.
index.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently removes the local plan, participant consent record, transcript, notes, and review draft. Tutoring transport history is managed separately.

session.consentDescription: Each person chooses transcription, recording, Sentinel, and camera separately. Starting the room never overrides a missing choice.
session.criteriaHint: Used by the local follow-up recommender
session.localRecord: Transcript and notes stay in the active profile database
session.notGossiped: No interview content is published to P2P gossip
session.recordChoicesFirst: Record every requested participant choice first.
session.unassignedRemote: {count} remote caption segment(s) were not stored because no consenting participant could be matched.
session.emptyTranscriptHint: On-device speech recognition appears only when the WebView guarantees local processing. Manual attributed entry is always available.
session.manualPlaceholder: Add what the selected speaker said…
session.speaker: speaker
session.assistantHint: Local, deterministic prompts · verify before asking
session.suggestionsEmpty: Suggestions appear after transcript evidence arrives and target vague claims, individual contribution, trade-offs, and uncovered criteria.
session.notesPlaceholder: Only this active profile can see these notes.
session.consentIntro: Review each choice with the participant. They can decline any optional capture or revoke all choices later.
session.attributedTranscriptHelp: Stores text with this participant's display label.
session.recordingHelp: Requested by this interview plan; remains off without this choice.
session.sentinelHelp: Behavioral and environment signals are scored on this device.
session.cameraSentinelHelp: Face presence, count, identity consistency, gaze, and second-device cues. Raw camera frames are not retained by Sentinel.
session.inviteHelp: This ticket joins the underlying end-to-end live room. Share it through a trusted channel.
session.deviceHelp: Device identifiers stay on this device and are used only by the active live room.
session.sentinelDebugHelp: The complete live debug surface from the current tutoring/assessment build. These are observations for the interviewer—not automatic conclusions about a person.

review.label: Review
review.subtitle: Verify the generated draft against timestamped transcript evidence before sharing.
review.summaryHint: Generated locally from coverage states and recent attributed excerpts.
review.conclusionPlaceholder: Document your decision and rationale. Keep observations separate from inferences.
review.disciplineTimestamp: Check each important claim against a timestamp.
review.disciplineSentinel: Treat Sentinel signals as context, never an automatic verdict.
review.disciplinePii: Remove irrelevant personal information before export.
review.disciplineSharing: Obtain a fresh lawful basis before sharing outside this device.
review.transcriptHint: {count} final segments. Speaker attribution can be checked against the interview timeline.
review.exportHint: Exports are created only on this device. Pseudonyms are enabled by default and private interviewer notes are excluded.
review.pseudonymsHint: Recommended whenever identity is not required by the recipient.
review.includeNotesHint: Off by default because notes may contain unverified impressions.
review.retentionHint: This record is scheduled for deletion after {count} days.
review.expirySweep: Opening the interview list triggers an expiry sweep. Manual deletion is available from the interview list at any time.

live.diagnosticsHint: Connection, media, transport, and device details for troubleshooting.
live.diagnosticsEmpty: No active session diagnostics are available.
